model: 795 Blade RS 2 RIVAL AXS / LOOK R45S
description: If there were only one left, it would be this one. The ultimate racing bike, the fastest work of art ever to emerge from our workshops. We designed the 795 BladeRS to win, which it did from its very first season in the hands of the Cofidis team’s riders. More than 20 victories – including four stages in Grand Tours – later, our iconic colours are once again ready to shine, with this Iconic Platinum White version that symbolises our history and our vision. Lightweight, aerodynamic and stiff, the 795 BladeRS is a distillation of technology and craftsmanship. It offers you the unique sensations delivered by a competition machine.
